stat_descriptions.damage: Per swing/cast: rolls a value in [min, max].
stat_descriptions.str: +{N} Strength — boosts max HP and melee damage.
stat_descriptions.dex: +{N} Dexterity — boosts crit chance and haste.
stat_descriptions.int: +{N} Intelligence — boosts spell damage, spell area, and spell duration.
stat_descriptions.armor: Subtracts {N} from each incoming physical hit (post-crit).
stat_descriptions.evasion: +{N}% chance to fully dodge an incoming attack.
stat_descriptions.crit_chance: +{N}% chance per swing to deal crit damage.
stat_descriptions.crit_multiplier_pct: Crits deal +{N}% more damage (a crit normally deals 150%).
stat_descriptions.block_chance: +{N}% chance to block an incoming hit. A block cancels the whole hit.
stat_descriptions.damage_pct: +{N}% damage on every hit, weapon and spell.
stat_descriptions.item_rarity_pct: +{N}% to upgrade-tier rolls on every drop.
stat_descriptions.lifesteal_pct: Heals you for {N}% of damage dealt.
stat_descriptions.fire_dmg_pct: +{N}% fire damage on spells AND weapon hits.
stat_descriptions.cold_dmg_pct: +{N}% cold damage on spells AND weapon hits.
stat_descriptions.lightning_dmg_pct: +{N}% lightning damage on spells AND weapon hits.
stat_descriptions.holy_dmg_pct: +{N}% holy damage on spells AND weapon hits.
stat_descriptions.poison_dmg_pct: +{N}% poison damage on spells AND weapon hits.
stat_descriptions.dark_dmg_pct: +{N}% dark damage on spells AND weapon hits.
stat_descriptions.fire_extra: Adds {LO}-{HI} fire damage to each hit.
stat_descriptions.cold_extra: Adds {LO}-{HI} cold damage to each hit.
stat_descriptions.lightning_extra: Adds {LO}-{HI} lightning damage to each hit.
stat_descriptions.holy_extra: Adds {LO}-{HI} holy damage to each hit.
stat_descriptions.poison_extra: Adds {LO}-{HI} poison damage to each hit.
stat_descriptions.dark_extra: Adds {LO}-{HI} dark damage to each hit.
stat_descriptions.physical_extra: Adds {LO}-{HI} physical damage to each hit.
stat_descriptions.loot_rarity_bonus: +{N}% to upgrade-tier rolls on every drop.
stat_descriptions.aggro_bonus: +{N} tiles to enemy aggro radius (enemies notice you from farther away).
stat_descriptions.gold_pickup_radius_cells: Magnet: gold within {N} more tiles flies to you automatically.
stat_descriptions.spell_tome_drop_pct: +{N}% chance per boss kill to drop a bonus spell tome.
stat_descriptions.synergy_pct: +{N}% all damage when you carry STR, DEX, AND INT affixes together.
stat_descriptions.sage_per_unspent_pct: Up to +{N}% spell damage when you have unspent stat points (10+ for full bonus).
stat_descriptions.berserker_peak_pct: Unlocks a Bot Instructions rule condition. Berserker: HP low + peak ramp active This enables an instruction rule; it does not add damage by itself.
stat_descriptions.str_dmg_per5_peak_pct: +{N}% damage scaling with your STR (peaks around +50 STR).
stat_descriptions.echo_every_n: Every {N}-th swing fires a free echo strike.
stat_descriptions.sundering_per_stack: Each hit weakens the target's armor by {N} (stacks up to 2×).
stat_descriptions.bloodletting_per_stack: Each hit bleeds the target for {N} damage/sec over 4s.
stat_descriptions.spell_fireball_ground: Fireball: leaves a burning patch on impact.
stat_descriptions.spell_iron_dust: Iron Shot: pierced enemies are slowed for 1.5s.
stat_descriptions.bleed_on_miss: On a missed melee swing: 100% chance to apply a 3s bleed (4 dmg/s).
stat_descriptions.dancing_blade: On melee hit: 25% chance to fire an extra weapon-damage strike at the same target.
stat_descriptions.polymorph_first_kill: First kill each floor splits into a friendly slime (50 ATK, 1 floor lifespan).
stat_descriptions.wolf_kinship_pct: +{N}% damage to wolf-family enemies (wolf, hound, hell hound, wolf spider).
stat_descriptions.hp_per_kill_cap: +1 max HP per kill on this floor (cap +{N}; resets each floor).
stat_descriptions.tidesong_water_pct: +{N}% damage to enemies standing on water tiles.
stat_descriptions.venom_on_hit: Each melee hit applies 1 stack of poison (3 ticks × 0.5s, max 5 stacks).
stat_descriptions.phylactery_revive_pct: Once per floor: revive at {N}% max HP on lethal damage.
stat_descriptions.fifth_cast_pct: Every 5th spell cast deals +{N}% damage (counter resets each floor).
stat_descriptions.low_hp_dr_pct: Take {N}% less damage while below 40% HP.
stat_descriptions.boss_dmg_pct: +{N}% damage to bosses, elites, and uniques.
stat_descriptions.weapon_bleed_per_sec: Each hit bleeds the target for {N} damage/sec over 4s.
stat_descriptions.holy_dot_per_sec: Each hit burns the target for {N} holy damage/sec over 3s.
stat_descriptions.revenge_dmg_pct: +{N}% damage for 3s after you take a hit.
stat_descriptions.first_hit_pct: +{N}% damage on your first hit against each enemy.
stat_descriptions.hp_per_kill_flat: +{N} max HP per kill (this floor only).
stat_descriptions.melee_armor_pen_pct: Your melee hits ignore {N}% of enemy armor.
stat_descriptions.spell_resist_pen_pct: Your spells ignore {N}% of enemy elemental resistance.
stat_descriptions.crit_mark_dmg_pct: Crits mark the target — marked enemies take +{N}% damage for 4s.
stat_descriptions.dmg_vs_status_pct: +{N}% damage to enemies suffering a status you inflicted.
stat_descriptions.spell_comet_split: Fireballs fork toward two nearby enemies at half damage.
stat_descriptions.spell_ember_wake: Impacts leave a burning patch on the ground.
stat_descriptions.spell_freeze_dur_pct: Freeze lasts {N}% longer — a wider Shatter window.
stat_descriptions.spell_spore_burst: The cloud bursts outward, covering a wider area.
stat_descriptions.spell_vulnerability_surcharge_pct: You take {N}% MORE damage — the price of the power.
stat_descriptions.reaction_relay: Reactions RE-ARM the status they consume — keep hitting and the combo repeats.
stat_descriptions.glass_prism: Your damage counts as EVERY element: any spell can trigger any reaction.
stat_descriptions.hollow_vessel: Auras reserve NO mana — but your maximum mana is halved.
stat_descriptions.spell_curse_spread: The curse spreads to {N} further enemy(s).
stat_descriptions.spell_consecrate: Pillars leave consecrated ground that blesses you.
stat_descriptions.spell_ravenous: Drain heals more and hastes you on hit.
stat_descriptions.spell_bounce_retain_pct: Ricochets keep {N}% of the damage they would have lost.
stat_descriptions.spell_wrath_kindle: Wrath sets nearby enemies burning when it ignites.
stat_descriptions.spell_chain_bonus: Your projectiles, spell and wand alike, chain to {N} more enemy(s); each hop hits a little softer.
stat_descriptions.support_chain_bonus: This spell's projectiles chain to {N} more enemy(s); each hop hits a little softer.
stat_descriptions.recoup_pct: Heal {N}% of damage taken over the next 4s.
stat_descriptions.thorns_flat: Unlocks a Bot Instructions rule condition. Thorns: any return-damage source equipped This enables an instruction rule; it does not add damage by itself.
stat_descriptions.block_thorns_flat: On block, reflect {N} damage to the attacker.
stat_descriptions.first_hit_mark_pct: Your first hit marks the target — they take +{N}% damage from anything for 3s.
stat_descriptions.riposte_dmg_pct: On evade/block: counter-strike for {N}% of weapon damage.
stat_descriptions.high_hp_cdr_pct: Spells cool down {N}% faster while above 90% HP.
stat_descriptions.kill_streak_cdr_pct: On kill, build a stack of spell cooldown reduction (up to 4). Fades after 3s.
stat_descriptions.crit_chain_pct: On crit, chain to the nearest enemy for {N}% of the crit's damage.
stat_descriptions.retribution_pct: When struck, holy pillars smite the attacker and up to 2 nearby enemies for {N}% of weapon damage (4s cooldown).
stat_descriptions.loot_quantity_pct: +{N}% chance to drop an extra item on each kill.
stat_descriptions.dot_duration_pct: Unlocks a Bot Instructions rule condition. DoT extension: dot_duration_pct > 0 This enables an instruction rule; it does not add damage by itself.
stat_descriptions.mana_floor_start_flat: +{N} mana at the start of each floor.
stat_descriptions.visual_umbral: Umbra — on a hit you take, 8% chance to blind the attacker.
stat_descriptions.visual_twisted: Twist — 8% chance per hit to apply a random elemental DoT.
stat_descriptions.visual_prismatic: Prism — your damage cycles through fire, cold, lightning, poison.
stat_descriptions.visual_inverse: Inversion — your HP-gated affixes flip: hunter fires at low HP, executioner at high HP, glass cannon at low HP, etc.
stat_descriptions.physical_dmg_pct: +{N}% physical damage on weapons and spells.
stat_descriptions.arcane_dmg_pct: +{N}% arcane damage on weapons and spells.
stat_descriptions.aura_reservation_pct: Aura mana reservation changes by {N}% (a negative value reserves less mana).
stat_descriptions.archmage_per_mana_pct: Spells deal +{N}% damage per point of mana spent on the cast.
stat_descriptions.high_mana_spell_dmg_pct: +{N}% spell damage while your mana is at least 75% full.
stat_descriptions.mana_on_spell_hit_flat: Spell hits restore up to {N} mana per cast.
stat_descriptions.free_cast_proc_pct: {N}% chance for a spell cast to cost no mana.
stat_descriptions.mana_shield_pct: Spend mana to absorb {N}% of incoming damage while mana remains.
stat_descriptions.is_kiting_flag: Unlocks a Bot Instructions rule condition. An enemy is nearby and there is somewhere to retreat. This enables an instruction rule; it does not add damage by itself.
stat_descriptions.is_executing_flag: Unlocks a Bot Instructions rule condition. The target has low enough health for a finishing attack. This enables an instruction rule; it does not add damage by itself.
stat_descriptions.is_glass_cannon_flag: Unlocks a Bot Instructions rule condition. The character has enough health to fight at full strength. This enables an instruction rule; it does not add damage by itself.
stat_descriptions.is_hunting_boss_flag: Unlocks a Bot Instructions rule condition. The current target is a boss. This enables an instruction rule; it does not add damage by itself.
stat_descriptions.is_pacifist_flag: Unlocks a Bot Instructions rule condition. No enemy is standing next to the character. This enables an instruction rule; it does not add damage by itself.
stat_descriptions.is_grinding_flag: Unlocks a Bot Instructions rule condition. Enemies or visible loot remain on the floor. This enables an instruction rule; it does not add damage by itself.
